text_block_list.text: The legend has been—rewritten.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!! HOW'S 
THAAAT!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A sweeping victory for Mejiro Ryan!! With 
an all-out, brilliant run, she surpasses 
Oguri and McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Traaiiineeer!! Khhh!!

I held her close. Her supple body was 
burning hot... and trembling like a 
child's.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. I'm glad we could have 
such a good race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Miss Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Now, make your way to the winner's circle. 
The victory is yours—Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I gave it everything I gooooot!!

The call of victory began with a roar true 
to Mejiro Ryan's style.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to win both of 
my target Grand Prix races this year, the 
Takarazuka and the Arima...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I believe it's all because I used my time 
properly. Righteous effort will always 
bear fruit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still... there is something more important 
than effort.

"Beyond hard work"? That was a phrase I 
had never heard from Mejiro Ryan before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It is—someone who truly watches and 
acknowledges all your hard work!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If the fans hadn't been watching me, I 
would've never been chosen in the fan 
vote..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Before my debut, back when I couldn't 
believe in myself at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There was someone who recognized my steady 
training and truly believed in me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That person believed that I would stand in 
this place. Even when I didn't believe in 
myself, they believed in me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that—I am standing right here 
today!!

Ruminating on Mejiro Ryan's words, I 
clenched my fist.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please don't give up on 
yourselves. Even if you lack glamour, you 
can still become a star.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Even I was able to win the two major 
Grand Prix! You can do it if you try!! 
Try, and you'll open the path to the 
future!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I ran today because I wanted to share 
these words with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all soooo muuuuuuuch for your 
suppoooorrrt!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentleman in a Beret
text_block_list.text:
Ryan! Ryan! Haha, I just knew you'd come, 
I really did!

The fans and gentlemen are in a frenzy, 
Mejiro McQueen is in tears. And Oguri Cap 
is――

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Left something unfinished, did I?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I thought I had accomplished everything in 
the Twinkle Series. But...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with that Umamusume once 
more—no, as many times as it takes. With 
the Mejiro Ryan you trained.

Those eyes were undeniably those of 
someone utterly spellbound. Mejiro Ryan 
had become a horse girl capable of 
mesmerizing even a superstar.

And so, the Arima Kinen reached an 
emotional finale.
